reviews.text:
We recently had our pool built by Texas Outdoor Oasis, and the entire experience was exceptional from start to finish. We worked with Michael Mueller, who helped us design the perfect pool for our home. He was knowledgeable, patient, and really understood our vision.

Our project manager, Allan, was equally fantastic. He kept us informed every step of the way, making sure we always knew what was happening and what to expect next. His communication and organization made the whole process smooth and stress-free.

They also connected us with a landscaping contractor, Bo, who designed beautiful landscaping that fit perfectly within our budget. His creativity and attention to detail truly completed the look of our new outdoor space.

To top it off, they even set us up with Aaron, a very knowledgeable technician who taught us everything we needed to know about how our new pool works. He made the learning process simple and confidence-boosting.

The team as a whole was quick, efficient, and incredibly informative throughout the project. Our pool turned out beautifully, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jenna Teixeira

reviews.text:
We had an awesome experience with this Texas Outdoor Oasis! Michael designed an amazing space, and Charles managed the project and made sure it was smooth and everything was handled at the highest standard. They built our pool, covered patio, and outdoor kitchen, and everything turned out amazing. The communication was great from start to finish — they kept us updated, answered every question, and made the whole process super smooth.

The crew was professional, always cleaned up after themselves, and paid attention to every little detail. You can tell they really care about their work and their customers. We absolutely love how everything turned out and would 100% recommend them to anyone thinking about adding a pool or outdoor space!
reviews.author: Penny Greeno

reviews.text:
We recently completed an outdoor kitchen and patio project with Texas Outdoor Oasis, and we couldn’t be more thrilled with the entire experience!!! From start to finish, the process was seamless and exceeded every expectation.

Jennifer did an incredible job with the design! She listened closely to our vision and then elevated it into something far beyond what we could have imagined. Her eye for detail and ability to maximize both function and style turned our backyard into a true oasis.

Charles was an outstanding project manager as well! He kept everything on schedule, communicated with us every step of the way, and made sure even the smallest details were executed perfectly. His professionalism and commitment gave us confidence throughout the build.

The craftsmanship is top-notch, and the end result is absolutely stunning. If you’re considering an outdoor project, I can’t recommend Texas Outdoor Oasis highly enough.

Jennifer and Charles are a great team! Creative, reliable, and truly dedicated to delivering a first-class experience.
reviews.author: Austin Cain

reviews.text: Charles was our project manager and they worked great with us even as we added and subtracted things as it went. It turned out high quality which is why we chose Texas Outdoor Oasis. Nicer than even I could picture. Patio tied into roof and landscaping , irrigation and sod. Small kitchen, heater, fans, lighting.
reviews.author: Rebekah Wright

reviews.text:
If you are looking for an incredible pool build experience, look no further than Texas Outdoor Oasis! We are absolutely blown away by our new backyard paradise. From the initial design to the final walk-through, the entire team was professional, communicative, and brilliant.

The visionary designer, Michael Mueller, truly deserves immense credit. He took our ideas and transformed them into a breathtaking reality, perfectly integrating every feature we requested: a relaxing sun shelf, dynamic water features, a stunning grotto, and a gorgeous, custom-designed waterfall. The final design exceeded our wildest expectations.

Equally impressive was the construction phase, led flawlessly by Shawn Garretson. Shawn managed the build with exceptional detail, kept the project on track, and ensured that every element was executed with precision and high-quality craftsmanship. His commitment to making sure we were happy throughout the process was unmatched.

This is more than just a pool; it’s truly an outdoor oasis, exactly as the company name promises. We highly, highly recommend Texas Outdoor Oasis, Michael Mueller, and Shawn Garretson for anyone wanting an amazing, custom outdoor living space! Thank you for giving us the pool of our dreams.
reviews.author: Jason Glenn

reviews.text: Our pool designer was Michael. He planned out our pool better than we had envisioned. Shawn was our daily project manager. The weekly updates were spot on. Everyone was personal and easy to get ahold of. The major freeze came right after the pool was complete and they both helped us prep the pool for the storm. We would 100% recommend them to friends!
reviews.author: Miles and Natalie Kirkley

reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with our experience working with this pool company!  From the very first consultation to the final touches, the entire process was seamless and exceeded our expectations.

Michael listened carefully to our ideas, understood our vision, and took it to the next level transforming them into a stunning backyard oasis design.  Michael was available throughout the entire process and made small change orders stress free.

Shawn, our project manager, was extraordinary.  He kept everything running smoothly, communicated clearly, and made sure every step of the build stayed on schedule.  Shawn answered all of our questions throughout the build and kept us informed of next steps as the work was performed.  His professionalism and dedication gave us total peace of mind throughout the project.

If you’re looking for a team that combines talent, reliability, and genuine care for their clients, call Texas Outdoor Oasis and ask for Michael & Shawn
reviews.author: Angela McDowell

reviews.text:
If you are having a pool built, this is the company.  Troy Cole was our designer and he met the huge challenge of our very limited space and our utility easement with a beautiful design.  I can honestly say that he used every available inch for us!  Shawn Garretson was our project manager and this is the first time we have ever seen a major project such as this go exactly as they said it would at every stage.  My wife and I were impressed with every crew sent to our home and everything from the pool design to the decomposed granite side yard addition is first rate.

The last thing I would say is that I don't believe it's normal for both your designer and your project manager to be so readily available for any questions or concerns through the entire project.  I would request those guys, every time.
reviews.author: Bryan Merckling

reviews.text:
Worked with Jennifer through sales and design process and she was very professional even through several changes in the scope of the project. Shawn took over at the beginning of the project and he was very thorough and professional as well.
The whole project went well, he was very informative keeping me updated on progress and was an easy process.
Would recommend to anyone looking for outdoor work.
reviews.author: Craig Hestand

reviews.text: Love, love, love, the Texas Outdoor Oasis family. We started with Michael and our design. Told him what we wanted and he didn’t disappoint, right down to the 3D rendering. I needed this to be a turnkey project. When they weren’t able to do something Mikey had a guy and each of those guys were as professional and timely as TOO. Construction went swimmingly! Shawn G. kept things moving and kept me informed of the who, what, when, where. We had a couple of hiccups but they were handled to everyone’s satisfaction without any additional cost or stress. We finished with Bo in the landscaping department. I had some unique ideas for the landscaping. He never blinked! He embraced my vision with excitement and creativity. I now have the backyard of my dreams, low maintenance, peaceful, very and clean. Thanks to everyone at TEXAS OUTDOOR OASIS. (Fence by Richardson Fence-Angel, Trampoline by Jumpy Joeys)
reviews.author: Joanna Erwin

reviews.text:
We had a great experience with Texas Outdoor Oasis and love our new outdoor patio! It really transformed our backyard and we’re enjoying it already.

John and Jen were extremely helpful, friendly, and informative throughout the entire process from design, to construction updates, and coming by in person to check on progress along the way. The crew was always respectful, efficient, and cleaned up after themselves.
reviews.author: Devyn Shinde

reviews.text:
We cannot begin to express how glad we are that we went through Texas Outdoor Oasis for our pool.    We had no idea what we wanted to do with our space since it was kinda small. We knew we wanted a tanning ledge and a volleyball pool, but that was it. Troy helped us design the most amazing pool for our space. All of our friends are going nuts for the layout. It is perfect for what we want to do with our pool. We have a tanning ledge, volleyball pool, and we have a corner with a horseshoe bench for a cocktail area, complete with a screw in table. It’s perfect.
We also couldn’t have asked for a better PM. Charles was ONTOP of it! He sent us weekly updates, kept us in the loop as to what is happening next, and kept the project moving. Luckily, we had clear skies 99% of the time. We were able to get all of this done over a month ahead of schedule. They work LIGHTNING fast. We couldn’t believe how many people they had working at one time. Charles, you have no idea how much we appreciate you.

The travertine, the outdoor kitchen, the pool, the landscaping… all of it is better than we could have dreamed. I will only be recommending Texas Outdoor Oasis to anyone who wants a pool. Troy and Charles are your guys.
reviews.author: Kylie Walker

reviews.text: We were extremely happy with our pool and landscape installation.  Ira was our designer, and his experience and knowledge of pool construction wqs what made us choose Texas Outdoor Oasis.  Charles was our construction project manager, and was great to deal with.  I would highly recommend their services.
reviews.author: Ryan Mills

reviews.text: This company did the re-plaster of my 13,000 gallon pool that was over 20 years old. Tony was up front about what I needed and did not need. No unnecessary up-sales. Alan was great as the project manager and kept us well advised on when the different teams would be here. I am totally happy with the work and final product.
reviews.author: Stan Martin

reviews.text: We wanted to add a new patio but wanted it to look like it was originally part of the house. We had several companies come out but Michael at Texas Outdoor Oasis was the only person who was able to understand what we were looking for. Every time I had a question or need our project manager Shawn was very quick to get me an answer and was always more than courteous.  Now that the porch is complete we are thrilled with how it turned out. I would say that it is better than the renderings.
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with my pool remodel! From the initial consultation with Tony to the final reveal, the team was professional, communicative and attentive to my vision. Tony and Shawn took my 25 year old pool and turned it into a stunning oasis with sleek new tiles and efficient lighting. The craftsmanship is top-notch and every detail was handled with care. Highly recommend this team to anyone looking to elevate their outdoor space!
reviews.author: Marci Stanley

reviews.text:
Texas Outdoor Oasis converted our inground 12K gallon pool to a saltwater system.  This included installing a Jandy saltwater chlorine generator and the power pack.  I received a few different bids on the work, including my original pool builder who I was more inclined to give the work to originally.  Tony, who is responsible for remodels and repairs at TOO, convinced me otherwise.  He is extremely responsive, polite, knowledgeable, and professional.  He responded to all my texts almost immediately and answered every single question I had.

The installation itself was perfect.  The tech was on time and very considerate, even asking my wife beforehand if it was okay to back his truck into the driveway.  He managed to fit the new equipment into my existing setup efficiently and discretely.  It doesn’t look like the work was done after the fact, which was important to me.

After the install, Tony gave me a very detailed lesson on my new equipment, the newly added options in my pool’s app, and again answered all the questions I had.

I appreciate Tony’s approach and professionalism.  He will definitely be my go to person if I have any future issues with my pool.
reviews.author: Benny Yee

reviews.text: If you are in the market for a pool or backyard upgrade do yourself a favor and talk with Texas Outdoor Oasis. The pictures don’t do it justice. Troy and Shawn helped transform our backyard into a space we will be able to enjoy. From start to finish the communication was superb and the craftsmanship impeccable. You will not be disappointed if you choose Texas Outdoor Oasis!
reviews.author: Nathan Haupt

reviews.text: We are very pleased with the landscaped design and work performed by the Texas Outdoor Oasis group. Bo and Joe worked with us to create a backyard design and addressed our drainage issues as well. We will definitely use them again and highly recommend Texas Outdoor Oasis for any outdoor projects!
reviews.author: William Latham

reviews.text: Texas Outdoor Oasis transformed our backyard into a resort. The project began in mid January and was completed in Mid April. Sales rep Michael and project manager Charles were great in terms of communication and they were easy to contact during the project. Their showroom made it very easy to pick out the pool finishes and they provided excellent recommendations for the pool tile, color of plaster, pavers etc. Their landscape sub did a fantastic job and their fencing sub did a fantastic job as well. The pergola is fantastic and it blends with the house as if it was part of the original construction. Pricing was reasonable for the entire project. The few glitches which are inevitable on any project, were addressed and taken care of easily. As per the photos attached, the pool, landscaping and fencing look incredible and again, our backyard has been transformed into a resort. We look forward to enjoying the pool and the backyard for many years to come. Our kids and grandkids will as well. We could not be more pleased with the work done by Texas Outdoor Oasis. We highly recommend Texas Outdoor Oasis if you are planning to build a pool.
reviews.author: Bill Adams

reviews.text:
Texas Outdoor Oasis was founded on building patios, that is apparent. We hosted Thanksgiving and several said, “I don’t remember your patio being so large”, it is because it looks like it’s part of the house! They build a nice pool as well! Ask for Michael M. and CB, they are both awesome!
CBH
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text: Texas Outdoor Oasis did an outstanding job installing our pool! From start to finish, the entire process was smooth, well-organized, and completely stress-free. Their team was extremely professional, communicative, and respectful of our property throughout the build. The quality of their work is truly tremendous—every detail was done with care and precision, and the final result exceeded our expectations. We couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. I would highly recommend Texas Outdoor Oasis to anyone looking for a top-quality pool and a great overall experience.
reviews.author: Joey Pena

reviews.text:
We cannot say enough great things about Texas Outdoor Oasis and the incredible team that made our backyard vision a reality! From start to finish, Caleb, Troy, and Bo went above and beyond to ensure that every aspect of our project was completed with top-notch craftsmanship and attention to detail.

Our project included a pool, arbor, roof extension, landscaping, outdoor kitchen and decking, and every element turned out better than we could have imagined. Caleb was fantastic in keeping us informed and making sure everything stayed on track. His expertise and hands-on approach made the process smooth. Troy’s design met all of our needs. He truly listened to us.  Bo’s suggestions on landscape was perfect. The team’s quality work was evident in every detail.

The entire team was professional, communicative, and truly cared about creating a space we would love for years to come. The craftsmanship and quality of work exceeded our expectations, and they tackled every challenge with ease. If you’re looking for a company that delivers on their promises and transforms your outdoor space into something amazing, Texas Outdoor Oasis is the one to call!

Thank you, Caleb, Troy, and Bo, for your hard work and dedication—we are absolutely thrilled with our new outdoor space!
reviews.author: Platonic Canoe

reviews.text:
Texas Outdoor Oasis completely exceeded our expectations on our backyard patio addition. This was a large investment in our home so choosing a company to work with was an important decision. Jennifer designed our patio space and worked so well with me to help make our vision a reality. I had a specific architectural design and finishes that I wanted to use and she was on the same page with me day one. She got my vision and the design turned out even better than I could have imagined.

When it came time to make our design a reality and build out the space, Charles managed the construction process professionally with excellent communication and precision. The crews that Texas Outdoor Oasis used for our project were not only excellent but also left our property clean every single day. Charles managed the project timeline impeccably and even though we fully anticipated hiccups, there were no problems at all and the project truly could not have gone smoother. We are so happy with our experience from the initial design to the construction and finish out.

Thank you, Jennifer, Charles and the whole Texas Outdoor Oasis team. We could not be happier customers. (The last pic is the before pic)
reviews.author: Emily Crouse

reviews.text: We trusted Texas Outdoor Oasis with our pool build and we are happy with the end product. It was completed on schedule despite some weather delays. Communication was good.
reviews.author: B Pettet

reviews.text: Bo and his team did a fantastic job from start to finish. He listened to what we wanted, made suggestions and worked up a fantastic design. From start to finish, his team was on time and emailed a report every day of their progress. The whole project was completed in the time line given and within budget. I highly recommend Texas Outdoor Oasis because they did a phenomenal job on our landscape restoration. We love our new landscape!
reviews.author: Bill Brummitt

reviews.text:
Texas Outdoor did an exceptional job building our patio and outdoor kitchen, far exceeding our expectations. After months of researching and comparing multiple companies in my area, I narrowed it down to three companies for quotes, and Texas Outdoor stood out.

Their excellent reviews and impressive portfolio initially caught my attention. They ultimately earned my business by being responsive, knowledgeable, honest, and transparent about costs and timelines. They worked within my budget while delivering results that went above and beyond.

I worked with Courtney on the design, and she was fantastic—always prompt, attentive, and skilled at bringing my ideas to life through the rendering. They invited us to their showroom, where we could see and select materials in person, ensuring we were informed and satisfied throughout the entire process. Charles, our project manager, was equally outstanding. He was highly knowledgeable and kept us updated every step of the way.

I’m thrilled with the final product and can’t wait to work with Texas Outdoor Oasis on my next project. I highly recommend this company to anyone looking for quality and professionalism.
reviews.author: Carlos Garcia

reviews.text:
Although this is our forever home and we had planned for years to expand our outside living area by expanding our covered patio, adding an outdoor kitchen and fireplace we struggled with design ideas.  Because I am in the service business I see a lot of outdoor kitchens and beautiful landscaped yards.  So when I came across Oasis a few years ago I noted their work for future reference.

We were impressed with the tour of similar work we wanted to do and decided to move forward.  Courtney was our designer and Charles was our project manager.  Courtney is a whiz on the computer.  She was able to take our ideas, digitize our property and produce a design based on our input.  The 3D rendering was amazing. We ultimately had Oasis not only expand our backyard living area, but landscape our front/side yards as well.

Both Courtney and Charles were receptive to design changes, new ideas and last minute updates which Charles took in stride coordinating the various crews to ensure everything was done in a timely manner.  Their crews were efficient, quiet and cleaned up each day.

The end result was above and beyond our expectations.  Attached are a few pictures of the backyard as well as the front/side yard.
reviews.author: Mike Childers
